name: Laser–EMAT Inspection System
激光–电磁超声检测系统
overview: Single-sided, non-contact inspection of thick metallic components with laser excitation and EMAT reception.
结合脉冲激光激励与 EMAT 接收，对厚壁金属构件进行单侧非接触检测。
hardware: Pulsed laser, electromagnetic acoustic receiver, specimen fixture, precision translation stage and high-speed digitiser.
脉冲激光器、电磁超声接收器、试样夹具、精密位移平台及高速采集设备。
contribution: Designed and integrated the platform, commissioned its acquisition workflow and modelled the offset source–receiver geometry.
设计与集成平台，调试采集流程并建立偏置收发几何模型。
control: Coordinates pulsed excitation and time-domain capture for dense stepped scans, coarse single-pulse scans and preliminary continuous-motion experiments.
协调脉冲激励与时域采集，用于密集步进、粗步距单脉冲及初步连续运动实验。
capabilities: Finite-aperture-aware imaging of deep defects; separation and analysis of mode-converted arrivals.
深层缺陷有限孔径成像、模式转换到达信号的分离与分析。
results: Research summaries cover deep-defect imaging, mode conversion and continuous-motion acquisition.
相关研究涵盖深层缺陷成像、模式转换与连续运动采集。

name: Air-Coupled Laser-Ultrasonic System
空耦激光超声检测系统
overview: Non-contact inspection of composites and reflective surface topography measurements.
对复合材料实施非接触检测，并以反射式测量获取表面形貌。
hardware: Pulsed laser, air-coupled ultrasonic receiver, beam scanner or translation stage, and acquisition electronics.
脉冲激光器、空耦超声接收器、光束扫描器或位移平台及采集电子设备。
contribution: Contributed to experimental system development, automation, measurement methodology and validation in composite-inspection studies.
参与复合材料检测实验系统研发、自动测控、测量方法和实验验证。
control: Automated scanning and triggered acquisition capture ultrasonic signals for imaging and analysis.
自动扫查与触发采集获取用于成像和分析的超声信号。
capabilities: Composite microstructure and interfacial defect inspection, broadband measurements and 2.5-D topography of rough surfaces.
复合材料微观结构与界面缺陷检测、宽带测量及粗糙表面 2.5-D 形貌重建。
results: Published composite-interface validation and rough-surface topography measurements.
已发表复合材料界面缺陷验证与粗糙表面形貌测量成果。

name: Automated Measurement Software
自动化实验测控软件
overview: LabVIEW software for repeatable instrument-driven ultrasonic experiments.
使用 LabVIEW 开发软件，支持重复执行由仪器控制的超声实验。
hardware: LabVIEW host, acquisition hardware, laser and motion controllers configured for each experimental setup.
LabVIEW 主机，以及按实验配置的采集硬件、激光器和运动控制器。
contribution: Independently developed instrument communication, multi-device coordination, automated scan workflows and real-time visualisation.
独立开发仪器通信、多设备协同、自动化扫查流程及实时可视化。
control: Configures hardware triggering, sample rate and acquisition window, coordinates timing and captures high-speed time-domain signals.
配置硬件触发、采样率与采集时窗，协调时序并采集高速时域信号。
capabilities: Instrument sequencing, live waveform review and spatial data collection for subsequent A-, B- and C-scan analysis.
仪器时序控制、实时波形查看及空间数据采集，为后续 A、B、C 扫描分析提供数据。
results: The linked publication documents a hardware-synchronised acquisition workflow used in laser cleaning.
关联论文记录了激光清洗研究使用的硬件同步采集流程。

name: Laser Scanning & Precision Motion Control
激光扫描与精密运动控制
overview: Automated spatial scanning for laser-ultrasonic wavefield measurements and process monitoring.
用于激光超声波场测量与过程监测的自动化空间扫查。
hardware: Galvanometer, motorised translation stage, pulsed laser and data-acquisition system.
振镜、电动位移台、脉冲激光器与数据采集系统。
contribution: Developed scan and capture workflows, including trajectory planning and coordination across the laser, motion and acquisition devices.
开发扫查与采集流程，开展轨迹规划并协调激光、运动及采集设备。
control: Galvanometer trajectory control, stage commands, laser triggering and time-domain acquisition.
振镜轨迹控制、运动平台控制、激光触发与时域采集。
capabilities: Repeatable spatial scans for wavefield reconstruction, measurement and process monitoring.
用于波场重建、计量与过程监测的可重复空间扫查。
results: Published laser-cleaning scans illustrate spatial registration of process measurements.
已发表的激光清洗扫查展示了过程测量的空间配准。

name: Optical Ultrasonic Measurements
光学超声测量
overview: Hands-on experimental experience with laser interferometry and optical ultrasonic detection.
具有激光干涉与光学超声接收的实验操作经验。
hardware: Laboratory laser interferometer and associated optical ultrasonic measurement instruments.
实验室激光干涉仪及相关光学超声测量仪器。
contribution: Operated laboratory instruments for optical ultrasonic measurements.
操作实验室仪器开展光学超声测量。
control: Optical alignment and measurement setup for recording surface displacement or wavefields.
进行光路调节与测量配置，采集表面位移或波场。
capabilities: Surface-displacement measurement and optical observation of ultrasonic wavefields.
表面位移测量及超声波场的光学观测。

name: Nonlinear Ultrasonic Testing
非线性超声检测
overview: Hands-on experience operating nonlinear ultrasonic instrumentation.
具有非线性超声仪器系统的实验操作经验。
hardware: Laboratory excitation, reception and signal-acquisition equipment.
实验室超声激励、接收与信号采集设备。
contribution: Operated experimental instrumentation and worked with the acquired signals.
操作实验仪器并处理所采集的信号。
control: Configured excitation and reception and acquired time-domain signals for analysis.
配置激励与接收，采集时域信号用于分析。
capabilities: Experimental operation, ultrasonic signal acquisition and analysis.
系统操作、超声信号采集与分析。
